objective.name: sandbox.dsl.aggregate.params.mixed.matters
objective.description: Aggregate params from several previous capacities and pass both wrapper-owned and remote matters into the final wrapper call.

#root.role: Aggregate final params from multiple previous sub-responses and resolve both a local wrapper matter and a remote Brique matter in the final wrapper call.

effects.multi_source_param_aggregation: Final params are built from multiple previous capacity responses.
effects.wrapper_matter_read: A wrapper-owned matter is read in the final wrapper call.
effects.remote_matter_read: A remote matter is read in the final wrapper call.

transformation_contract.morphing: A DSL request becomes one final wrapper response after aggregating params from multiple sub-responses and resolving both local-wrapper and remote-Brique matters.
invariants: The final wrapper call receives label from the root input, message from sandbox.build.record, source_ctx from remote read.state, and @matter refs from sandbox.build.matter_refs.
The local wrapper-owned matter and the remote Brique matter are both resolved by the terminal wrapper call rather than inline in the DSL itself.
success: The terminal payload exposes received_params and resolved_matters from sandbox.inspect.resolved.inputs.
received_params.@matter carries both the local wrapper matter ref and the remote Brique matter ref, while resolved_matters exposes their resolved contents.
failure: The flow fails if sandbox.build.record, remote read.state, sandbox.build.matter_refs, or the final wrapper resolution step fails.
The flow fails if either referenced matter cannot be resolved by the terminal wrapper.
notes: This scenario validates mixed local-wrapper and remote-Brique matter references flowing through one DSL orchestration.
N7 verifies both the raw received @matter refs and the resolved contents returned by the wrapper.
